claims.claim: Neatly used Disc of watch Dogs legion PS4
claims.evidence: Witness only saw the PS4 game case cover art (photo 0). No disc presence/condition was shown, and no working status or originality details were visible.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip showing the disc removed from the case (or the disc inside the case) with the disc visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / disc not confirmed.

risks.risk: Disc condition may be poor (scratches) or not working
risks.proof: A short video of the disc being inserted and the game starting (or a test/boot screen) on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / high risk of failure.

risks.proof: A photo showing the inside of the case contents (insert/manual) laid out or clearly visible.

risks.risk: Originality may be uncertain (copy vs original)
risks.proof: Photos of the disc label/printing details and any matching identifiers (e.g., Sony/pressing marks) plus the back cover/serial info.
A photo of the disc label and/or back cover showing region/compatibility markings.

risks.risk: Case/cover may have hidden damage (cracks, heavy fading, stickers)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front cover, spine, and back cover from multiple angles under light.

proof_requests: Show whether the disc is included: photo/clip with the disc visible (inside and/or removed).
Show disc condition: close-up of the disc surface (scratches/scuffs).
Show it works: short video of the game launching on a PS4.
Show case completeness: photo of the inside contents (insert/manual) and what’s missing.
Show originality/identifiers: clear photos of disc label and back cover/serial details.
Show region/compatibility markings: photo of disc label/back cover region info.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a PS4 game case for Watch Dogs: Legion, so it can be priced at the worst case. However, disc inclusion/condition and authenticity are not confirmed from the photo, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
